title: SophisticatedStorage issue #514: [1.21.1] Missing recipes - EMI compatibility
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (NOASSERTION) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by 2ndkirbyever]
The copper storages - except for shulker boxes - and the pump upgrades are missing recipes as of version 1.21-0.10.45.910.
You can still upgrade storages to copper even though they do not display in recipe viewers.

Test steps:

1. Search for @sophisticatedstorage copper in the recipe viewer of your choice.
2. Try viewing the recipe of a copper storage.
3. Nothing happens.
4. Replace copper with pump in the search bar.
5. Try viewing the recipe of the pump upgrade, advanced pump upgrade and the experience pump upgrade.
6. Nothing happens.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
Pump doesn't have a recipe because there's no fluid storage in the mod yet. And when you say copper storage what do you mean - any specific item?

[comment by 2ndkirbyever (none)]
Any copper-tier storage block, except for shulker boxes. Neither barrels, limited barrels, nor chests have a visible recipe. In this instance, I’m using a combination of JEI and EMI. EMI gets recipes from JEI when both are installed together, then JEI is hidden automatically. I can check if the recipes are visible in JEI, though.

[comment by 2ndkirbyever (none)]
Update: The storage recipes are visible in JEI, but not in EMI.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
I have no idea why EMI would not show the recipes as they are not different from other tiers and are registered to JEI exactly the same way. I may take a look at EMI compatibility as I don't have any compatibility specifically for EMI. Until then you can either take it to EMI or just wait for when/if this compat may happen.

[comment by P3pp3rF1y (owner)]
we now have proper EMI compat in the latest versions of sophisticated mods and I don't see this issue happening anymore so closing.
